parameters.name: ComparisonOperator
parameters.description:
The comparison operator for the threshold. Valid values:

- `>=`

- `=`

- `<=`

- `>`

- `<`

- `!=`.

parameters.name: ContactGroups
parameters.description: The alert contact group. Separate multiple alert contact groups with commas (,).

parameters.name: EffectiveInterval
parameters.description: The time range during which the alert rule is effective. Valid values: 00:00-23:59.

parameters.name: EmailSubject
parameters.description: The subject of the alert email.

parameters.name: EvaluationCount
parameters.description: The number of retries for the alert.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the application group to which the custom monitoring data belongs.

> A value of 0 indicates that the reported custom monitoring data does not belong to any application group.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description:
The severity level of the alert. Valid values:
- CRITICAL: critical.
- WARN: warning.
- INFO: information.

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description:
The name of the metric.

> For information about how to obtain the metric name, see [DescribeCustomMetricList](~~115005~~).

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The aggregation period of the custom monitoring data. Unit: seconds. The value must be 60 or a multiple of 60. Default value: the original reporting period of the custom monitoring data.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: The custom monitoring data to which the alert rule applies. The value consists of the application group ID to which the custom monitoring data belongs and the dimensions of the metric.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the alert rule.

> If the alert rule ID already exists, the alert rule is modified. If the alert rule ID does not exist, an alert rule is created.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the alert rule.

parameters.name: SilenceTime
parameters.description:
The mute for period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (1 day).

> If monitoring data continuously exceeds the alert rule threshold, only one alert notification is sent within each mute for period.

parameters.name: Statistics
parameters.description: The statistical method for the alert.

parameters.name: Webhook
parameters.description: The webhook URL that is called when an alert is triggered. A POST request is sent to this URL.
